A subsequent Compare against reference index 1 at 3-cycle scale unexpectedly identified a *different* anomaly at [2985,3010]: a localized high-frequency shapelet burst during decay phase (5–6 zero-crossings in 25 pts), absent in references. This suggests the initial candidate interval [2865,2910] may be part of a broader non-stationary transition zone, and the true anomalies are two distinct events: (1) a trend onset at ~2912, and (2) a shapelet burst at ~2985–3010. Uncertainty remains about whether the flat segment (2821–2914) is anomalous due to missing oscillation or contextually normal; no evidence supports the original double-peak hypothesis after detail inspection.
